tasks.description: Score deployed landing at all shipping viewports. Target benchmark ≥7.5 weighted.
Capture baseline screenshots (light+dark) at all shipping viewports for visual regression.
Manual QA pass: broken links, empty hrefs, mobile layout, CTA repeatability.
Synthesize audit findings into prioritized fix list (P0/P1/P2).
If P0 bugs found: root-cause each, produce bugfix briefs.
Plan P0 fix implementation. If no P0 bugs, skip with justification.
Implement P0 fixes. Skip if audit found none.
Run G5 review-gate on executed change set. 5-step protocol: self-review → self-judgment → cross-review → convergence → gate decision.
Land P0 fixes. Re-run benchmark to prove delta improvement.
